title: Implement COBOL file, linkage, and CALL semantics
digest_scope: Recursively lexicographically key-sorted compact UTF-8 JSON serialization of file_call_receipt, with no trailing newline, followed by SHA-256
acceptance_observations: SELECT metadata lowers logical name, DD assignment, organization, access mode, record/relative key, and FILE STATUS into typed executable definitions; sequential, indexed, and focused relative declarations are tested.
Invocation cobol.dd.<SELECT> bindings override the declared assignment as explicit runtime authority; absent overrides use the lowered ASSIGN name rather than raw source text.

READ keys use explicit KEY operands or lowered random record/relative keys, READ INTO mutates the exact record view, WRITE FROM emits the selected bytes, and successful, empty, or condition results update FILE STATUS deterministically.
CALL USING encodes bounded ordered by-reference values in mainframe-env.cobol.call@1 and accepts only an exact mainframe-env.cobol.call-result@1 arity before mutating caller storage.
A selected-route host roundtrip proves caller storage changes from AB to XY, while a DD-bound dataset read proves USER.INPUT authority, record mutation, and status 00 output.

The pinned corpus contains 54 file bindings, 185 linkage layouts, 63 CALL statements with 228 USING operands, and the exact reached OPEN/CLOSE/READ/WRITE inventory; CBSTM03A, CBSTM03B, and CSUTLDTC are all present.

commands.command: focused CALL USING and DD-bound READ tests before repair
commands.result: by-reference return and file-status mutation were absent
